# 01-investigate-runtime: Investigate Project Runtime Library

## Objective
Read the .vcxproj file to confirm RuntimeLibrary settings and the list of linked libraries to identify cause of LNK4098 (defaultlib 'MSVCRT' conflict).

## Research Findings

### Project
- Project file: Q:\MDS\Y2S1\3Dgraphics\GD1P04-OpenGL\OpenGL_Project\OpenGL_Project\OpenGL_Project.vcxproj
- PlatformToolset: v145
- WindowsTargetPlatformVersion: 10.0

### Relevant settings discovered
- The project uses <UseDebugLibraries> true/false per configuration instead of explicit <RuntimeLibrary> entries.
  - Debug|x64 configuration: <UseDebugLibraries>true</UseDebugLibraries>
  - Release|x64 configuration: <UseDebugLibraries>false</UseDebugLibraries>
- Linker AdditionalDependencies (Debug|x64 and Release|x64): opengl32.lib;glfw3.lib;glew32.lib;%(AdditionalDependencies)

### Likely cause of LNK4098
- LNK4098 indicates a mismatch between CRT default libraries (MSVCRT) and other object/library inputs. Possible causes:
  - One or more linked third-party libs (glfw3.lib, glew32.lib) were built with a different CRT (static vs dynamic) than the current project configuration.
  - The project relies on <UseDebugLibraries> which can map to different /MDd vs /MTd behavior depending on the imported props; absence of explicit <RuntimeLibrary> values makes the intended CRT ambiguous when mixing third-party libs.

### Files to Modify (proposed)
- Q:\MDS\Y2S1\3Dgraphics\GD1P04-OpenGL\OpenGL_Project\OpenGL_Project\OpenGL_Project.vcxproj
  - Add or set explicit <RuntimeLibrary> entries per configuration (e.g., MultiThreadedDebugDLL for Debug (/MDd) and MultiThreadedDLL for Release (/MD)).
  - Alternatively, if third-party libs are static CRT builds, consider using MultiThreaded (/MT) variants or obtain DLL builds of those libs.

### Risks & Notes
- Changing RuntimeLibrary may require rebuilding or replacing third-party libraries (GLFW, GLEW) to match the selected CRT. If those libs are provided as prebuilt static libs with mismatched CRT, adjusting the project may not eliminate the linker warning without updating them.
- A conservative first change is to explicitly set RuntimeLibrary to the DLL variant (/MDd for Debug) to align with modern MSVC defaults and then rebuild to check whether LNK4098 is resolved.

## Decision / Next steps
This investigation recommends proceeding to Task 02: Apply Project Runtime Fix (edit .vcxproj to set explicit <RuntimeLibrary> entries and then validate). Do not modify project files in this task.
